verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent tracing auto-instruments popular AI SDKs and captures LLM call spans. The LLM Calls view shows token usage, cost and response performance, and traces support investigating latency. Prompt and response content can be captured through `data_collection` or `recordInputs`/`recordOutputs`, though it is off by default. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of LLM trace capture, explicit per-call latency field documentation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture traces of my LLM calls with inputs, outputs, latency, and token usage

citations.quote: **LLM Calls** shows individual model requests. Use it to compare models, prompts, token usage, cost, and response performance
Use it to follow execution across model calls, tools, and services or to investigate latency and errors in context.
Prompt and response content is off by default — use the `gen_ai` key of the [`data_collection` option](/platforms/python/configuration/options/#data_collection) to capture it.
You can also set `recordInputs` / `recordOutputs` on a specific AI integration.
Sentry auto-instruments the most popular AI SDKs and frameworks out of the box
